# WIRE — Wire protocol

- Owner: `ticonnect-core`
- Stage: 5
- Layer: `domain`
- Component graph: [generated/components/wire.md](generated/components/wire.md)

## Purpose

Define versioned postcard framing for handshake, sync, messages, acks, transfers, audio, video, input, calls, and limits.

## Boundary

Pure encoding and decoding contracts. No sockets, storage, or daemon state.

## Owned state

- None

## Invariants

- `INV-DISC-1` — Discovery produces candidates only and never implies trust. Test: crates/net/tests/discovery.rs
- `INV-LIMIT-1` — Every queue, buffer, and frame decoder is bounded or declares its drop policy. Test: planned: design review plus fuzz tests
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-TLS-1` — Certificate pinning fails closed on unknown or mismatched fingerprints. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/tls.rs
- `INV-TRUST-1` — No non-pairing feature is reachable before trust is established. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/unpaired_rejected.rs

## Failure semantics

- reject oversized frames
- unknown version rejected
- decode never panics
- golden vectors required

## Open decisions

- frame version negotiation
- stream versus datagram split
- audio and video packet layouts
